definitions.gloss: discounted price; reduced price; sale price
definitions.explanation: A price that has been lowered from the original or standard amount. Used in shopping, business, and everyday commerce.

examples.japanese: {割引|わりびき}{価格|かかく}で{購入|こうにゅう}できる。
examples.english: You can buy it at a discounted price.

examples.japanese: {会員|かいいん}は{割引|わりびき}{価格|かかく}が{適用|てきよう}される。
examples.english: The discounted price applies to members.

examples.japanese: {期間|きかん}{限定|げんてい}の{割引|わりびき}{価格|かかく}で{販売|はんばい}しておりますので、この{機会|きかい}にぜひどうぞ。
examples.english: We are selling at a limited-time discounted price, so please take advantage of this opportunity.

notes:
A straightforward compound of {割引|わりびき} (discount) and {価格|かかく} (price). Widely used in advertising, store signage, and online shopping. While {割引|わりびき} alone can modify nouns, the full compound {割引|わりびき}{価格|かかく} is preferred when the focus is specifically on the numerical price.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {割引|わりびき}{価格|かかく}で{買|か}う: to buy at a discounted price
- {割引|わりびき}{価格|かかく}が{適用|てきよう}される: a discount is applied
- {特別|とくべつ}{割引|わりびき}{価格|かかく}: special discounted price
- {学生|がくせい}{割引|わりびき}{価格|かかく}: student discount price

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {定価|ていか}: list price; retail price — the original price before any discount
- {半額|はんがく}: half price — a specific type of discount
- {特価|とっか}: special price; bargain price — implies a particularly good deal
